mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(c.code_name, p.extra_attributes ->> 'role', '기타') AS roleName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM hrm_person p LEFT JOIN com_code c ON p.position_code = c.code AND c.parent_code = '103' AND c.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE p.service_status_code = '101-010' GROUP BY COALESCE(c.code_name, p.extra_attributes ->> 'role', '기타') ORDER BY count DESC
